abstract: Dispatches coding work over one resident WebSocket that owns many agent processes (Grok, Claude, Codex, Cursor) through the acpw CLI. acpw up starts that socket; acpw run returns a session_id that continues the conversation across connections, child respawns, and daemon restarts when the agent advertises loadSession. The host agent keeps planning, scoping, and verification; workers only execute. Every command prints one JSON line, and an ok result means the ACP turn ended, not that the task is correct.
